findings.title: CVE-2026-76964: SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP (Internet Communication Manager)
findings.summary_md: CVE-2026-76964 is a critical vulnerability rated CVSS 10.0 in SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP (Internet Communication Manager) where insufficient validation of certain network input can lead to memory corruption. An unauthenticated attacker can send specially crafted network traffic to trigger the flaw, potentially executing arbitrary code and fully compromising the system. SAP published the CVE record on November 10, 2026 as part of its November Security Patch Day.

findings.title: CVE-2026-89119: SAP Web Dispatcher and Internet Communication Manager
findings.summary_md: CVE-2026-89119 is a critical cross-site request forgery flaw rated CVSS 9.6 affecting SAP Web Dispatcher and SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP (Internet Communication Manager), arising from insufficient request validation in certain administrative functions. An unauthenticated attacker can trick a logged-in administrator into visiting a malicious link, causing unintended administrative actions that can lead to full compromise of the underlying operating system. SAP published the CVE record on November 10, 2026 as part of its November Security Patch Day.

findings.title: CVE-2026-89126: SAP Web Dispatcher
findings.summary_md: CVE-2026-89126 is a critical heap-based buffer overflow rated CVSS 10.0 in SAP Web Dispatcher caused by insufficient validation of certain network input processed by an internal component. An unauthenticated attacker can send specially crafted network traffic to achieve arbitrary code execution and full system compromise. SAP published the CVE record on November 10, 2026 as part of its November Security Patch Day.
